def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row),
             key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))

    # Identify the compact multicolor stamp; the scattered color is the
    # one appearing outside that connected cluster.
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    comps = []
    unseen = set(cells)
    while unseen:
        stack = [unseen.pop()]
        comp = []
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            comp.append((r, c))
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p)
                    stack.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    stamp_comp = max(comps, key=len)
    stamp_set = set(stamp_comp)

    # The stamp is the connected object containing the distinct 1 anchor.
    stamp_cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in stamp_comp]
    ar, ac = next((r, c) for r, c, v in stamp_cells if v == 1)
    offsets = [(r-ar, c-ac, v) for r, c, v in stamp_cells if v != 5]
    targets = [(r, c) for r, c in cells if (r, c) not in stamp_set]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in targets:
        for dr, dc, v in offsets:
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = v
    return out
